# g3-toolkit

> Composable graph-visualization component LIBRARY (not a framework) for
> RDF, labeled-property-graph (LPG), and holonic data: @g3t/core (zero
> React), @g3t/react (views + controls), @g3t/charts (linked ECharts).
> Hosts integrate through exactly three channels: exported zustand
> stores, props/callbacks, and versioned JSON documents. TypeScript,
> React 19, pnpm (enforced), Cytoscape + Graphology, Zustand.

The native data model is the UGM, a labeled property graph (typed nodes
and edges with arbitrary properties) over Graphology. Everything else
(RDF triples, relational rows, holonic datasets) projects into it.
Reasoning and heavy algorithms run UPSTREAM (triplestore, networkx,
GraphBLAS) and arrive as validated result documents: "results, not
computation".

## Packages and entry points

- @g3t/core (no React): subpath exports `.` (UGM, algorithms, export,
  SHACL, structural layout), `./adapters` , `./middleware`, `./events`,
  `./projection`, `./pipeline`, `./shacl`, `./diff`, `./layout`,
  `./algorithms`, `./undo-redo`, `./theme`, `./path-analysis`.
- @g3t/react: subpath exports `.`, `./views`, `./controls`, `./state`,
  `./theme`, `./a11y`, `./icons`, `./timeline`, and `./style.css`
  (REQUIRED import, see rules below). Peer deps are NOT auto-installed:
  react, react-dom, cytoscape, cytoscape-fcose, zustand, echarts.
  vis-timeline and vis-data are OPTIONAL peers, needed only for
  `@g3t/react/timeline`; every other entry point resolves without them.
- @g3t/charts: `LinkedChart` (bar, scatter, line, pie), auto-links to
  the shared selection store. Peers: @g3t/core, @g3t/react, react,
  echarts.

## Core API surface (the names an agent should reach for)

- Data model: `UGM`, `SerializedUGM`, node/edge input and attribute types.
- Backends: `SparqlAdapter` (SELECT bindings only), `CypherAdapter`,
  `GremlinAdapter`, `RestAdapter`, `HolonicAdapter`; `Middleware` on all.
- RDF to LPG: `createPresetPipeline("standard" | "ontology" |
  "provenance-preserving").project(rdfGraph)` or compose a
  `ProjectionPipeline` with steps like `typeCollapse`.
- SHACL: `validateShacl`, `reportFromValidationResults`,
  `parseShaclReport`, `severityOverlays`, `shaclResultDrivers`,
  `shaclShapesToStructural`, `shaclRowSeverities`, `closedShapeIds`.
- Structural (UML/SysML-style) layout: `layoutStructural`,
  `isChainEdgeId`, `routeStructuralEdges` (pure edge router, for live
  re-route during drags; opt-in `nudge` option separates parallel
  runs into distinct tracks, but by ruling it will KEEP runs bundled
  rather than spread them when spreading would raise the counted
  crossing number (lane overlap reads better than added crossings), so
  `nudge` is not a guarantee of separated tracks in dense storms);
  rendered by `StructuralSvgView`.
- Algorithms and scale: `parseAlgorithmResult`, `applyAlgorithmResult`,
  `ingestAlgorithmResults`, `findShortestPath`, `allShortestPaths`,
  `collapseByCluster`, `buildSubgraph`, `computeIncrementalUpdate`,
  `applyIncrementalLayout`; dense-scene edge bundling (FDEB, pure
  geometry): `bundleEdges` + `bundledPolylineToSegments` (projects
  onto the `curve-style: segments` polyline path; deterministic, no
  RNG; straight-line bypass past a `maxEdges` cap).
- Export: `exportSubgraphJson`, `exportSubgraphCsv`, `exportSubgraphTurtle`;
  raster snapshot of the live canvas via `buildImageExport` (@g3t/react
  toolbar, wraps native `cy.png`; the GraphToolbar export menu exposes PNG).
- Events: `G3tEventBus` (context-menu actions emit on it).

React: `CytoscapeCanvas` (props: ugm, encodingSpec, stylesheet, hidden,
containment, layout, layoutOptions, interactionOptions, edgeStyle,
animate, routeEdges (post-layout obstacle-aware A* routing on
non-structural scenes; runs at layoutstop, holds camera/positions;
`boolean | { maxEdges?, clearance?, bendPenalty?, minStub?, mode? }`
where `mode` defaults to "direct" = straight bezier unless the straight
line actually crosses a node body, exact segment test; "orthogonal"
routes every edge axis-aligned), routeRefreshSignal (counter bump:
re-route on current positions, no node move), relayoutSignal (counter
bump: crossing-aware re-place then re-route; explicit op, camera-hold
does not apply), edgeClickIsolate (edge tap isolates via emphasis
layer instead of selecting),
menuManager, structural + structuralDecorations +
structuralEdgeLayer (the structural path is DEPRECATED, see rules
below), onReady which hands you the Cytoscape Core),
`StructuralSvgView` + `useStructuralLayout`, `relayoutAroundFixed`,
`useElementPointerEvents`, `GraphToolbar`,
`EncodingSpecPanel`, `SpecLegend`, `FloatingLegend`, `AlgorithmPanel`,
`LayoutManager`, `Minimap`, `ProvenanceTrace`, `NodeStyleEditor`,
`SearchBar`, `FacetFilter`, `FilterBuilder`, `ContextMenuManager`,
`createDefaultMenuManager`, `registerToolkitActions`, `runGraphLayout`,
`createCameraController`, `createTheme`, `applyEncodingSpec`,
`labelWrapRule` (labels wrap by default at 110px; this is the override
knob: a number re-widths, `false` disables; pass via the `stylesheet`
prop, a position-preserving restyle),
`captureWorkspace` / `applyWorkspace` / `serializeWorkspace`, plus view
components: TableView, TreeView, MapView, MatrixView,
SankeyView, SchemaView, StatsPanel, QueryEditor, ShaclShapeBrowser,
DiffRenderer. TimelineView is on `@g3t/react/timeline` ONLY, and that
subpath is the only one needing the optional peers vis-timeline and
vis-data; importing it from `.` or `./views` does not resolve. Stores: `useSelectionStore`, `usePositionPinStore`,
`useOverlayStore`, `useThemeStore`, `useStyleOverrideStore`
(usable from React via selector or anywhere via `.getState()` /
`.subscribe()`).

## Correctness rules (types cannot express these; violating them is the
## most common AI-generated-code failure)

- Import `"@g3t/react/style.css"` FIRST. Without it every view renders
  unstyled with no error.
- `ugm` is compared by IDENTITY. Memoize it in the host; a new instance
  means "different graph" and re-runs layout. Content changes to
  `containment`, `layout`, `layoutOptions`, `interactionOptions`,
  `edgeStyle`, `animate` also re-initialize. `stylesheet` and
  `encodingSpec` changes are style refreshes and preserve positions.
- Filter by HIDING: pass node ids as `hidden` (a batched restyle).
  Never feed a pre-filtered UGM as `ugm`.
- For a genuinely different scene, use a keyed remount:
  `<CytoscapeCanvas key={sceneId} ugm={ugm} />`.
- Structural scenes: render with `StructuralSvgView` (the ruled
  path). Passing `layoutStructural` geometry to `CytoscapeCanvas` via
  the `structural` prop is DEPRECATED (owner ruling 2026-07-28; a
  dev-only warning fires) and will be removed once remaining
  consumers migrate.
- Deterministic styling escape hatch: the `_color` / `_shape` data
  channels. Reserved encoding channels reject by owner name.
- Graphs past ~5k nodes: collapse with `collapseByCluster`, drill in
  with `buildSubgraph`. There is no canvas virtualization.

## Cytoscape internals (paid-for lessons)

Only reach for the raw `cytoscape.Core` (from `onReady`) when the prop
surface cannot express what you need. When you do:

- **Field-scope every `data()` mapping.** `node[_size] { width: data(_size) }`,
  not `node { width: data(_size) }`. An unscoped rule fires one console
  warning per element per frame for every element missing the field —
  hundreds/second during animation, confirmed to stall the canvas.
- **`style().fromJson(…).update()` for style changes, never re-init.**
  Theme and spec changes must be restyles only; creating a new `cy` instance
  to change styles resets positions and the camera.
- **`cy.batch(() => { … })` for bulk writes.** Groups data stamps and class
  changes into one restyle pass. Used by every routing write in this repo.
- **`curve-style: segments` needs `edge-distances: node-position`.**
  The default `edge-distances: intersection` makes the chord run border-to-border.
  When terminals are placed at box centers (as `routeSceneEdges` does), omitting
  `node-position` shifts every bend by the node half-extent — the root cause of
  the v1.0.6 routing regression. Both props must be in the same rule block.
- **`segment-distances` sign convention.**
  Cytoscape draws a bend as `midpt(w) + (−dy/l, dx/l) * d`. For a bend at
  offset `(px, py)` from the midpoint, `d = (py*dx − px*dy)/len`. The opposite
  sign mirrors all detours across the chord. This is the specific error that
  shipped in `polylineToCytoscapeSegments` (wrong) vs `routeToSegments` in the
  structural path (correct); wrong-sign detours look fine until a node sits
  between source and target.
- **`boundingBox({ includeLabels: false, includeOverlays: false })`** for node
  geometry. Labels hang below the body and shift the center off the actual
  position, shearing routed bend points.
- **Exclude `isParent()` nodes from obstacle sets.** Compound parents have no
  drawn body; their children's boxes already cover the interior.
- **Multi-background needs bypass arrays, not data() arrays.** Use
  `n.style({ "background-image": [uri1, uri2], … })` per-element bypass for
  icon + badge stacks. Data() mappings with array values do not work reliably.
- **Negative `outline-offset` is silently rejected.** Use a positive value
  (gap outside the border, not inset). One warning fires at parse time.
- **`layoutstop` for post-layout work, not `layoutready`.** `layoutstop` fires
  after the animation ends; positions are final. Routing on `layoutstop` is
  why the brief bezier-to-route snap exists.
- **`cy.png({ output: 'blob' })`** returns a Blob; default is a data-URI string.
- **`cytoscape.use(fcose)`** must run at module level before any instance is
  created. Layout name in options: `"fcose"`.
- **Parallel edges / self-loops / bidirectional pairs** need `curve-style: bezier`.
  Detect in the element builder, stamp `_curveStyle = "bezier"`, gate via
  `edge[_curveStyle = "bezier"]` selector so other edges are untouched.
- **`:active` overlay** is a large gray blob by default. Slim it:
  `{ selector: ":active", style: { "overlay-opacity": 0.08, "overlay-padding": 4 } }`.

## Honest limits

SPARQL adapter parses SELECT bindings only (no CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE, no
full RDF-term typing). No SHACL-over-arbitrary-RDF shapes parser (the
validator uses the toolkit's internal shape form). No OWL/RDFS
reasoning, no named graphs/quads. Adapters are unit-tested against
mocked responses, not live backends. Structural compartment
expand/collapse was REMOVED by ruling (2026-07-10):
`useCompartmentCollapseStore`, `registerCompartmentCollapseActions`,
`compartmentKey`, and the `collapsedCompartments` layout input no
longer exist, even where older wiring-guide sections still show them.
Details:
[capabilities-and-limits](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/capabilities-and-limits.md).

## Docs

- [Wiring guide](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/wiring-guide.md):
  every integration recipe; each snippet runs in CI (examples/wiring/src/).
- [README](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/README.md):
  install, packages, minimal 15-line integration, honest scope,
  theming.
- [Capability index](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/capability-index.md):
  intent to demo/recipe/story lookup table.
- [Consuming g3t](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/consuming-g3t.md):
  adopter-side integration guide.
- [Structural patterns](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/structural-patterns.md):
  UML/SysML structural-scene recipes.
- [API reference (typedoc)](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/api/)
- [Playground](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/playground/): TEN
  deployed surfaces, live in the browser. Four domain shells (Auditor,
  MBSE, Supply Chain, Biomedical) and six capability surfaces:
  Analytics, Scale, Routing Lab, RDF 1.2 Hyperarcs, Legibility Lab,
  Ontology Workbench. Style Lab is dev-server only and so is NOT on the
  deployed page; Scale is the reverse, deployment-only. Legibility Lab
  is didactic pseudo-node spreading (hub burst and bus collapse) plus a
  holon boundary ring with a single exposed boundary node, with
  raw-to-spread toggles that hold the camera so the regrouping is
  followable. Routing Lab grades hard edge-routing scenarios live, with
  an Engine toolbar row exposing the live routing switches: nudge
  separation, long-edge perimeter threshold, anchor, placement and
  layering strategy, and effort budgets. RDF 1.2 Hyperarcs toggles the
  hyperarc and edge renders of the same triple-term rows over a nested
  fixture. The landing footer links this file, AGENTS.md, and the
  wiring guide.
- [Storybook](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/storybook/)
